runs.t: Eventual consistency means replicas converge to a compatible state if updates stop and communication proceeds, under the system's stated assumptions. It does not imply immediate read-your-writes behavior.

Distinguish stale reads, concurrent conflicting writes, causal ordering and convergence policy. Use version identifiers, conflict-resolution rules, monotonic views or session affinity where user experience requires them.
After a user changes their profile avatar, one region may briefly show the old image. A versioned asset URL can ensure the user's subsequent reads display the newly uploaded version.
'Last write wins' can silently discard legitimate updates. Convergence guarantees and read guarantees are separate; eventual consistency needs explicit UX and monitoring.
